_aiOverview.text: Posture is improving but two items need attention before the next Conditional Access change. MFA registration has risen steadily over the window and the secure score trend is positive, so the identity baseline is holding. The open risks are elsewhere: a device-dependent policy is still in report-only while a share of Windows sign-ins arrive without a device claim, and those sign-ins would be blocked on enforcement even though the devices are enrolled and compliant - a browser-SSO gap rather than a real compliance failure. Anonymous sharing links remain on two sites whose sharing ceiling still permits them. Priority: resolve the missing device claims, then re-read the report-only impact panel before enforcing. Note that a share of the report-only block count is a reporting artefact of device-based evaluation, so treat it as an upper bound, not a forecast of lockouts.
